coverage.catalog_method: Every selected document body was indexed; semantic reconciliation focuses on linked claims and implementation evidence. Not every historical document was independently re-audited.

phases.name: Evidence and authority
phases.entry: Inventory current source and existing owner trackers.
phases.exit: Claims have dated provenance; contradictions, restricted boundaries and owner decisions are explicit.

phases.name: Contracts and bounded implementation
phases.entry: A specific owner, contract and negative acceptance criteria exist.
phases.exit: Exact-head code and consumer conformance pass; implementation presence remains separate from runtime qualification.

phases.name: Provider, hardware and custody evidence
phases.entry: Relevant operation contracts and owner-approved provider scope exist.
phases.exit: Authenticated fresh provider evidence, replay/revocation and actual key/operation binding are independently accepted.

phases.name: Runtime and commercial integration
phases.entry: A real runtime/provider contract and accountable operator exist.
phases.exit: Actual deployment, data lifecycle, billing/entitlement, failures and rollback are demonstrated for the named capability.

phases.name: Release and independent acceptance
phases.entry: The exact artifact has its relevant contract/provider/runtime evidence.
phases.exit: Required CI, independent review, owner sign-off and real acceptance evidence bind the immutable release candidate.

phases.name: Deferred research and experiments
phases.entry: A bounded hypothesis and primary source are recorded.
phases.exit: Evidence supports a separate owner-approved pilot proposal, or the candidate remains explicitly deferred.

gaps.title: Complete the system graph CLI and installer contract

gaps.title: Verify the admin and service runtime

Demonstrate service health/dependencies, schema, errors and rollback on the exact artifact.
Historical disconnected/undeployed labels are not fresh provider observations.

gaps.title: Implement real billing, entitlement and provisioning

gaps.title: Remove root dependence and prove independent custody
gaps.next_action: Obtain current least-privilege identity, independently controlled custodians and exact operation/release proof.
acceptance: Three P-256 challenge signatures do not prove threshold signing, Bitcoin signing or separate custody.
Do not infer root access-key existence from an identity response.
No new infrastructure or custody changes are authorized by this inventory.

gaps.title: Qualify actual hardware providers and client authorization
gaps.next_action: Follow the existing provider matrix and obtain real device/firmware/driver, key-confinement and operation-binding evidence.
acceptance: Android chain/signatures/root/security-level and current revocation must verify.
Provider names and PKCS#11 C_Verify are inventory/operation facts, not hardware provenance.
Keep client authorization, platform attestation and actual protocol-key custody separate.

gaps.title: Operationalize collateral, revocation and durable replay
gaps.next_action: Bind authenticated fresh collateral and atomic consume-once behavior to real provider operations and recovery tests.
acceptance: Traits and single-process cache tests do not establish a distributed service.
Reject stale/revoked/wrong-root and replayed operation evidence.
Prove behavior across restart, replicas and recovery under the owner-selected backend.

gaps.title: Complete independent security and release acceptance
gaps.next_action: Arrange distinct authorized reviewers for exact artifacts and keep restricted details outside Git/GitHub.
acceptance: CI success, a merged packet or general user approval is not independent acceptance.

Sanitized coordination metadata may reference a pending restricted review without publishing reproduction details.

gaps.title: Complete phased rollout with exact acceptance evidence
gaps.next_action: Accept and release each capability only when its own exact artifact, checks, relevant provider/runtime proof and owner/reviewer gates pass.
acceptance: Do not label independent review the only missing cell.
Keep clean merges, CI, deployment, custody, support and release state separate.
No blanket freeze of independently accepted capabilities.

gaps.title: Revalidate positioning and economic research
gaps.next_action: Separate owner decisions, historical projections and primary-source observations before scoring or commercial adoption.
acceptance: Do not preserve speculative native-token economics as current authority.
External assets and independently evidenced staking adapters remain in scope.
No financial forecast, fee change or contractual SLA is approved by this register.

gaps.title: Complete institutional custody provider integration
gaps.next_action: Obtain an actual institution/provider account and qualified adapter contract with audited authorization and recovery behavior.
acceptance: Vendor names and SDK wrappers do not prove independent custody.
Do not provision accounts, move assets or substitute software custody.

primary_research.finding: Versioned payment requirements and signed authorization/verification/settlement are distinct from the local sats/payment-pointer facade.
HTTP uses PAYMENT-REQUIRED, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE and PAYMENT-RESPONSE transport contracts.
MCP transport defines structured payment-required results and x402/payment metadata, beyond a helper class.
Draft registry specification; payments are orthogonal. A semantic Stacks adapter is not proof of an EVM registry deployment.
Validate chain signatures, trusted roots, security level and revocation; real-device/operation evidence remains required.
